data.narrative:
Stacked Energy, founded by Dylan Erb and Sumitha Durairaj, is a Series A climate and energy technology company that has raised $98M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes nine identified peers—one public (LNZA) and eight private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—though none meet narrow peer-matching criteria at identical stage and valuation tier.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x multiplier to the $98M total capital raised as a proxy for entry valuation. This approach is appropriate for Series A positioning and yields an implied valuation of $196M. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable; while nine same-sector comparables exist, insufficient datapoints meet the filters for same-stage or adjacent-stage peers at similar valuation tiers, making sector-wide medians uninformative without materiality risk.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $167M to $225M, with a median point of $196M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct same-stage peer benchmarks within the Climate & Energy space, making relative validation difficult, and reliance on a single triangulation method. The undisclosed current valuation prevents calibration to actual fundraising terms. Further datapoints from subsequent Climate & Energy Series A closings would strengthen conviction in this range.
